verdict.rationale: Rippling publishes an official CLI in its own GitHub org (Rippling/rippling-cli), and a probe confirms it is documented there. Its Flux commands let first- and third-party developers create, manage and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations. The evidence shows a developer-scoped CLI for integrations only, with little detail on its commands or AI-native use. Missing for 10: evidence of CLI coverage beyond integration development (e.g., admin or HR data operations), in-depth command documentation, AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Flux commands as part of the Rippling CLI allow both first-party and third-party App developers to create, manage and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations.
